guard: the operator becomes a roster peer under the observer's own card on its first send
why: A peer that does not register presence leaves the operator invisible and every reply one-way; a peer under a fresh id advertises a roster entry that is not the sender of the operator's messages, so a reply to the `from` goes nowhere.
Each mutation is compile-clean and unique in the named file, and the suite imports src directly, so no build is involved.

mutations.name: P1 the peer does not register presence
mutations.expectRed: after the first send the operator is on the roster
mutations.cell: after the first send the operator is on the roster

mutations.name: P2 the peer takes a fresh id
mutations.replace: card: { name: observer.card.name, role: observer.card.role, kind: observer.card.kind },
mutations.expectRed: ...under the observer's own id, so it is the `from` of what the observer sends
mutations.cell: ...under the observer's own id, so it is the `from` of what the observer sends
